trust_limitation: The bundle was accepted only through a QA-created ephemeral Ed25519 root and test signatures. This is not production signing, publisher-key provenance, or release-artifact verification.
reproduction_steps: Start the exact-source runtime with isolated PostgreSQL 16 and Valkey, a non-superuser/non-BYPASSRLS database application login, and the documented tanpopo_webhook_worker role/membership required by the PostgreSQL webhook dispatcher.
Complete the real first-install wizard in Chromium and sign in as the synthetic owner.
Open Extensions -> Marketplace, stage @tanpopo/ollama, inspect the permission diff and explicitly consent to its loopback/private-IP permission expansion.
Select Approve & activate and capture the HTTP result and rendered notification.
